title: Charli xcx Announces 2027 U.K. & Europe Arena Tour With Audrey Hobert
summary: “I’m so ready to bring you this show that I love so much,” the singer wrote on X.
contentText:
Charli xcx is bringing her Music, Fashion, Film era to the United Kingdom and Europe in February, announcing a new run of arena dates in support of her latest album.

The trek kicks off Feb. 13 in Dublin, followed by stops in Glasgow, Manchester , London and Amsterdam, before wrapping Feb. 24 in Paris. Support will come from fast-rising pop act Audrey Hobert . See the full dates below.

Fans can access presale registration through Sept. 15 at Charli’s official website — where further ticketing information can also be found — with the presale running Sept. 16 – 17. “I’m so ready to bring you this show that I love so much,” she wrote on X .

The announcement follows a landmark summer for Charli, who topped the bill at Reading Festival on Aug. 28. The appearance marked Charli’s first headline performance at the event, and along with a slot at sister site Leeds, her only U.K. festival dates of the summer.

Charli xcx’s ‘Music, Fashion, Film’: All 11 Tracks Ranked

Reporting from the field, Billboard U.K. editor Thomas Smith wrote that Charli “commanded the stage with a singular focus and was bolstered by a live band in places and a group of dancers; the result was a statement of epic proportions,” add that “striking” stage production brought a “thrilling edge” to the 34-year-old’s performance.

The Reading set arrived just weeks after Music, Fashion, Film (July 24), Charli’s seventh studio album and the follow-up to 2024’s culture-dominating Brat. The album represents another sharp turn in the Essex-raised artist’s constantly evolving career, leaning into darkier, grittier rock sounds while continuing her fascination with celebrity and pop culture.

Music, Fashion, Film debuted at No. 1 on the Official U.K. Albums Chart , giving Charli her fourth U.K. chart-topper and making her the first British female artist to score two new No. 1 albums in the same calendar year (following February’s Wuthering Heights soundtrack). The new record opened at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 while also giving Charli her first No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Album Sales chart .

The North American leg of the Music, Fashion, Film tour will commence on Friday (Sept. 11) in Philadelphia. The 12-date arena trek includes stops in New York, Toronto, Boston, Atlanta and Los Angeles before wrapping in Las Vegas on Oct. 23. Electronic artist Underscores will join Charli on the road.

Charli xcx 2027 Tour of U.K. & Europe :
Feb. 13 — Dublin, IE
Feb. 15 — Glasgow, U.K.
Feb. 17 — Manchester, U.K.
Feb. 19 — London, U.K.
Feb. 22 — Amsterdam, NL
Feb. 24 — Paris FR
